purpose: Teach: 兵役/根絶/敵意/施政/余命/群集/沈下/借款

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に兵役のような厳しさは求めない
lines.en: We don't ask our staff to operate under military-grade discipline.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clean articulation on each phrase. Steady pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone setting a standard that will be held.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不正の根絶を社内で徹底しております
lines.en: Understood. We're maintaining strict protocols on fraud prevention across the company.
lines.style: Professional confirmation with underlying focus. Slightly clipped on the affirmative. Level, attentive tone—the response of someone taking detailed notes internally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合への敵意ではなく対話を目指せ
lines.en: Our goal with competitors is dialogue, not hostility.
lines.style: Clear strategic statement. Slight weight on 'dialogue'—emphasis through conviction rather than volume. Composed, looking slightly beyond the immediate moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新政府の施政方針を分析しております
lines.en: Understood. We're analyzing the new administration's policy direction.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Steady, slightly formal register. The tone of someone confirming they're tracking a complex landscape without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品の余命予測を在庫管理に活かせ
lines.en: Make sure product lifecycle forecasting informs our inventory strategy.
lines.style: Directive with underlying logic. Deliberate pace on the key term. No urgency, but clear expectation. The voice of someone who thinks several moves ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品発売イベントで群集対策を準備します
lines.en: Understood. We're preparing crowd management protocols for the new product launch event.
lines.style: Efficient, detail-oriented confirmation. Slightly faster pace than before—showing active planning in motion. Quiet competence without flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外拠点の地盤沈下リスクを評価しろ
lines.en: Evaluate subsidence risk at our overseas bases.
lines.style: Concise, serious. Slight pause before the directive lands. The tone of someone raising a potential liability that others may have overlooked. Expectant finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外借款を活用した新事業を検討します
lines.en: Understood. We'll explore new business opportunities leveraging overseas financing options.
lines.style: Professional closing. Steady tempo with slight forward momentum—indicating confidence in the strategic direction. Final confirmation before moving to the next agenda item.
